Be-Metal LEIP LAB EVAL-Nov21 J.P.W. Crozier, N.C. Fleming, DIST-AUG24 REV1-JUL24 20240830 ---- ENDF/B-VIII.1 MATERIAL 26 REVISION 1 ----- THERMAL NEUTRON SCATTERING DATA ------ ENDF-6
Temperatures = 77 100 293.6 296 400 500 600 700 800 1000 1200 K
HISTORY ------- 1. This library was produced by the Low Energy Interaction Physics (LEIP) group at North Carolina State University, USA. The thermal scattering law data for Beryllium Metal was developed using ab initio lattice dynamics (AILD) [1, 2]. Eleven temperatures are available in this library and extend into the cryogenic range. The Full Law Analysis Scattering System Hub (FLASSH) system was used to produce File 7 MT = 2, 4 data for Beryllium [3]. The coherent elastic data were prepared using the cubic approximation. MAT=26 and ZA=126 are used for Beryllium Metal. Elemental AWR and free-atom cross section were computed from MF=3, MT=2 at 1e-5 eV from the ENDF /B-VIII.0 nuclide evaluation [4].
